shots.title: Make sprint-state the active sprint source for status and briefing (#389)
shots.notes: Added active sprint-state precedence to sprint inference so status, briefing, claim defaults, and other inferred sprint commands agree with .slope/sprint-state.json.

shots.title: Promote adhoc session mode to sprint when a sprint starts mid-session (#387/#388)
shots.notes: Added session-mode synchronization that promotes an adhoc-pinned session to sprint mode whenever active sprint-state appears.

shots.title: Keep workflow guard suppression aligned with live sprint state (#387)
shots.notes: Routed adhoc guard suppression through live sprint-state synchronization so workflow guards no longer stay suppressed after mid-session sprint start.

shots.title: Add fresh-session and worktree regressions for sprint status/session mode drift (#387/#388/#389)
shots.notes: Added focused tests for sprint inference, slope status, guard suppression, and session-briefing dedup after sprint-state appears.

conditions.description: slope review recommend still selected a stale Sprint 29 plan, so PR review routing should use the concrete PR review command for this sprint.

training.description: Session mode is derived state; active sprint-state must be allowed to repair stale adhoc pins.
training.outcome: isAdhocSession now synchronizes with live sprint-state before suppressing sprint-workflow guards.

training.description: Sprint inference should prefer the explicit sprint-state file over stale config or copied worktree database state.
training.outcome: inferSprintContext now returns source=sprint-state for active sprint-state and ignores completed sprint-state as stale.

nutrition.description: Focused regressions, typecheck, build, compiled CLI smokes, full test suite, roadmap validation, and map check passed.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A compact repair with a clear source-of-truth boundary.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a guard suppresses based on session-local state, test the path where the underlying sprint state changes after the session has already started.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The narrow status fix was not enough; the shared sprint inference path needed the same precedence so briefing and claim defaults stay aligned.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The guard workflow is in better shape for the upcoming /review-pr enforcement work.

bunker_locations: Derived session_mode can drift from .slope/sprint-state.json unless guard suppression checks resynchronize before deciding.
Commands that infer a sprint from config/roadmap/scorecards must treat active sprint-state as the current local source of truth.
course_management_notes: Validation used pnpm vitest run tests/cli/sprint-inference.test.ts tests/cli/commands/status.test.ts tests/cli/commands/guard.test.ts tests/cli/guards/session-briefing.test.ts tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts.
Additional validation used pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, compiled CLI smokes for status/session-mode, pnpm test, slope roadmap validate, and slope map --check.
Issue #388 is a duplicate symptom of #387 and should be closed by the same PR.
